Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE large transparent square sprite sheet, exactly4 columns by4 rows, sixteen equal cells. Original reference1 defines Victamin anatomy; reference2 defines its cheerful eye/mouth vocabulary. They are character design authority, not backgrounds to reproduce.
Draw the SAME recognizable limbless paper-pompom mascot in all16 cells: exactly two long upright rounded rabbit ears, screen-left inner orange/right inner yellow; cream-white overlapping broad rectangular paper tabs with butter-yellow/apricot pieces, two orange square cheeks, small round dark brown eyes with a tiny white highlight and a thin U-shaped mouth. No fur or plain rabbit redesign. NO arms, hands, legs, feet, hat, props or extra characters. A rounded body wider than tall under its long ears. Keep the paper-layer arrangement, camera, proportions and warm light identical throughout. Shallow three-quarter toward RIGHT.
Clean crisp matte cel illustration, smooth antialiased edges, medium warm-taupe outline, sparse broad interior seams; no noisy tiny scratches, fuzzy texture, pixel dithering, blur, bloom or translucent white haze. Match a tidy warm cream calendar. Maximize native source detail: each entire mascot comfortably fills its own square cell, with generous transparent gutters around both ears and body. Consistent center and ground baseline88% in every cell. No frame borders, captions, symbols, tears, anger marks, motion strokes, speech or ground shadows. Genuine alpha transparency.
Cells1–8 form one gentle disappointed reaction in eight gradual poses, read left to right across rows1–2: neutral; noticing; gaze lowered; ears soften outward; quiet disappointed little downturned mouth, body settles; glance upward; ears lift; recover to the exact neutral ofcell1. Keep the character lovable and subtle, never suffering or crying.
Cells9–16 form one brief playful sulk and recovery across rows3–4: neutral; a small sideways glance; mild half-lidded eyes; tiny flat/downturned mouth with both ears lowered; a slight away lean without changing camera; glance back; soften mouth/raise ears; recover to the same neutral. No exaggerated angry eyebrows or new anatomy.
These are coherent expression keyframes of one character, not sixteen unrelated mascots. Preserve recognizable identity at every step.
